about: Every star in the HYG database (v4.4) within 100 light years (30.66 pc) of the Sun, in Galactic coordinates: x toward the Galactic centre (l = 0), y toward l = 90 deg (the direction of Galactic rotation), z toward the north Galactic pole, in parsecs from the Sun. Converted from HYG's equatorial x, y, z with the ICRS-to-Galactic rotation (Hipparcos, ESA 1997, vol. 1, sec. 1.5.3).
source: HYG database v4.4 by David Nash (astronexus), combining Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star, Gliese and Gaia data
caveats: HYG is complete for bright stars but misses many faint red and brown dwarfs (Gaia DR3 sees about 10,000 well-measured sources within 100 ly). Distances come from Hipparcos or Gaia parallaxes; spectral types are as catalogued (some missing). lum is in solar luminosities in the V band, from absmag.
